_doc: The barkeep's bar rag (docs/briefs/barkeep-rag.md), a prop that's cloth (ClothProp): a soft body of points that drapes over a shoulder, hangs from a hand and slumps on a bar top. Off-white linen, stained. Linen ~180 g/m2: 40 x 30 cm is ~22 g dry, ~35 g damp as a bar rag is. Caught by flames in about two seconds, burnt through in well under a minute (cotton and linen catch at ~250-400 C). Pressed on a wound, it takes up blood as a pad does (soaks: ml a ml of what bleeds under it).
